haa_006: You can recognise it as the oak growing near the statue Ontmoeting. It stands in the Wijngaardtuin, in the open.
haa_010: You can recognise it as the tree standing alone on open lawn, unlike the grouped beeches and oaks nearby. It stands in De Bolwerken, between the Noorderbrug and the Kruisweg crossing.
haa_012: You can recognise it by its crown showing above a villa's hedge. It stands within the private grounds of Statenbolwerk 1, viewed from the public footpath.
haa_017: You can recognise it by its leaves, white with felt on the underside, flickering pale when wind moves through the crown. It stands on a path beside the water, in the oldest section of the Kleverlaan cemetery.
haa_019: You can recognise it by its mottled cream, olive and grey bark, shedding in plates, and a short heavy bole with limbs reaching out almost horizontally. It stands on the green beside Houtplein, opposite the former ABN bank office.
haa_021: You can recognise it by its lower branches sweeping down toward the ground and its tidy, conical crown. It stands along the north-side path of Frederikspark.
